# Olive

> Olive is an asset-agnostic token adoption, security and interoperability framework at olivefinance.org. OLV is Olive's native platform token. External assets are adopted under integration-specific custody and representation terms.

Canonical: https://olivefinance.org/
App: https://wallet.olivefinance.org
Whitepaper: https://olive-whitepaper.census-explorer.workers.dev/

Olive is the successor to Clover Finance and Lucent Network, adopted by a new team. It is not affiliated with oliveapp.finance, Olive Capital, or Olive Foundation Nepal.

Current model: CLV → OCLV is a free 1:1 asset bridge. OCLV is not tradeable and is not listed on Trade. OCLV → OLV is a fixed 1:1 swap with a 1% fee in OCLV, shown before confirmation. OLV is tradeable only when Olive enables Trade. There is no user-facing migration flow.

## Framework
- [Framework](https://olivefinance.org/framework/): the asset-agnostic model.
- [OLV and asset roles](https://olivefinance.org/token/): native token and integration roles.
- [Adoption](https://olivefinance.org/adoption/): how an external asset enters the framework.
- [Integration case](https://olivefinance.org/adoption/clv/): the first adopted asset.
- [Security and custody](https://olivefinance.org/security/): controls and risks.
- [Interoperability](https://olivefinance.org/interoperability/): current scope and later direction.
- [Docs](https://olivefinance.org/docs/): framework reference.
- [Architecture](https://olivefinance.org/docs/architecture/): reference stack and execution path.
- [Team](https://olivefinance.org/team/): operators, advisors and investors.
- [Roadmap](https://olivefinance.org/docs/roadmap/)

## Product
- [Connected DeFi](https://olivefinance.org/features/connected-defi/): one route into supported networks and protocols.
- [Quantitative Investments](https://olivefinance.org/features/quantitative-investments/): research, models and analysis.
- [Agentic Trading](https://olivefinance.org/features/agentic-trading/): authorised agents acting within user limits.
- [Asset and Portfolio Management](https://olivefinance.org/features/asset-portfolio-management/): one view of positions and events.

- [LUX migration status: not in the initial CLV phase](https://olivefinance.org/blog/lux-to-olv-migration/): LUX was introduced by Lucent Network in 2025. Olive's initial framework phase targets CLV adoption into OCLV, not LUX. Here is the current status and scope.

## Notes
- Olive is in development. Nothing on this site is financial advice or a promise of returns.
- Integration-specific assembly, custody and representation terms live in the integration case study.
- The bridge address, swap fee and limits are shown inside the app after sign-in.
